mapper.sql: i.ABR_IMP_SN AS impactSn, i.ABR_SN AS reportSn, i.ABR_IMP_REF_TYPE_CD AS referenceTypeCode, i.ABR_IMP_REF_SN AS referenceSn, i.ABR_IMP_ACTION_CD AS actionCode, i.ABR_IMP_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, i.ABR_IMP_PREV_STATUS_CD AS previousStatusCode, i.ABR_IMP_PREV_START_DT AS previousStartAt, i.ABR_IMP_PREV_DDLN_DT AS previousDeadlineAt, i.ABR_IMP_REMAIN_START_SEC AS remainingStartSeconds, i.ABR_IMP_REMAIN_SEC AS remainingSeconds, CASE WHEN i.ABR_IMP_STLM_HOLD_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS settlementHoldApplied, i.ABR_IMP_RSLT_CN AS result, i.ABR_IMP_REG_ID AS registeredBy, i.ABR_IMP_UPDT_ID AS updatedBy
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ABUSE_REPORT_IMPACT i JOIN ABUSE_REPORT r ON r.ABR_SN = i.ABR_SN WHERE i.ABR_IMP_REF_TYPE_CD = #{referenceTypeCode} AND i.ABR_IMP_REF_SN = #{referenceSn} AND i.ABR_IMP_STATUS_CD = 'APPLIED' AND r.ABR_STATUS_CD IN (#{receivedStatusCode}, #{processingStatusCode}) ORDER BY i.ABR_IMP_SN LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ABUSE_REPORT_IMPACT i WHERE i.ABR_SN = #{reportSn} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ABUSE_REPORT_IMPACT ( ABR_SN, ABR_IMP_REF_TYPE_CD, ABR_IMP_REF_SN, ABR_IMP_ACTION_CD, ABR_IMP_STATUS_CD, ABR_IMP_PREV_STATUS_CD, ABR_IMP_PREV_START_DT, ABR_IMP_PREV_DDLN_DT, ABR_IMP_REMAIN_START_SEC, ABR_IMP_REMAIN_SEC, ABR_IMP_STLM_HOLD_YN, ABR_IMP_RSLT_CN, ABR_IMP_REG_ID, ABR_IMP_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{reportSn}, #{referenceTypeCode}, #{referenceSn}, #{actionCode}, #{statusCode}, #{previousStatusCode}, #{previousStartAt}, #{previousDeadlineAt}, #{remainingStartSeconds}, #{remainingSeconds}, CASE WHEN #{settlementHoldApplied} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{result}, #{registeredBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE ABUSE_REPORT_IMPACT SET ABR_IMP_STATUS_CD = #{statusCode}, ABR_IMP_RSLT_CN = #{result}, ABR_IMP_UPDT_ID = #{actorId}, ABR_IMP_UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ABR_IMP_SN = #{impactSn} AND ABR_IMP_STATUS_CD = #{expectedStatusCode}
